message: CME arrived at Mars 13 Nov 12:00 UTC (WSA-ENLIL). Dose not quantified; background rate shown.

replay.message: Replay of the 20 May 2024 solar storm: dose rate x38.6. Stay close to shelter.
replay.basis: event absorbed dose / mean daily absorbed dose (both mGy, Curiosity RAD); event spread over one day, same quality factor as background (conservative)
